audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 3 and 5 read 'Skill' and row 6 reads 'Vladimir', while the packet chart is Vladimir on rows 0-5 and Vayne on row 6 — and the prose (whys[6], spikes[3].text, late) already says two items is Vayne's window.
audit.why: 45.62% over 1234 games is a losing lane that only flips at full items; the chart contradicted its own explanations.
audit.corrected: phases[3]/win[3] and phases[5]/win[5] set to Vladimir, phases[6]/win[6] to Vayne, ratings moved with them.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].why called Blade of the Ruined King 'your spike — force fights', on a stage that is Vladimir's, and phases[6].why gave a generic side-lane line instead of the actual two-item flip.
audit.why: Crimson Pact turns his AP into health, so a raw-damage item does not out-race Transfusion; percent-max-health true damage plus Grievous Wounds is what does.
audit.corrected: Both stage explanations rewritten around the health-stacking and the Silver Bolts flip.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d carried no cooldowns and never stated the two interactions that decide the lane: Sanguine Pool's untargetability voiding the third Silver Bolt, and Tides of Blood being blocked by units.
audit.why: Sanguine Pool is 2s untargetable on 28/25/22/19/16s; Riot's own text for Tides of Blood says it 'can be blocked by enemy units'; Transfusion heals on 9s down to 4.6s.
audit.corrected: All four rewritten with the cooldowns, the minion-block on E, and the hold-the-proc rule.

audit.why: Executioner's Calling early and Mercury's Treads are already in report[8].t, matching the needs-antiheal finding.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Sanguine Pool's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Still his: Transfusion heals every 5.7s at rank 4 and Sanguine Pool eats any commit. Farm at range and buy Executioner's Calling early.

edits.before: Blade of the Ruined King is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Sanguine Pool's cooldown.
edits.after: Blade of the Ruined King is not enough yet — the health Crimson Pact stacks out-heals it until Grievous Wounds lands.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Vladimir carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on and Silver Bolts' true damage finally beats the health he stacked — fight him only while Sanguine Pool sits on its 16s.

edits.before: Dodges your burst. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Sanguine Pool (W) is 2s untargetable on 28s at rank 1 — commit after it.

edits.before: Vladimir wastes Sanguine Pool — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Tides of Blood (E) is 600 range and blocked by units — keep minions between you.

edits.before: That is Vladimir's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: He pools mid-combo to void your third Silver Bolt — hold the proc until W is spent.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Without Executioner's Calling, Transfusion refunds every trade you win.

notes: Riot's text explicitly states Tides of Blood 'can be blocked by enemy units', so the minion-block line is from the kit rather than inferred. Sanguine Pool's untargetability during Condemn's travel (whether an in-flight bolt still lands) is not answerable from the kits — left unstated.
